title: Welcoming the Migrants
paragraphs: Setelah meninggalkan Makkah, banyak Muhajirin tiba di Madinah dengan sangat sedikit harta. Kaum Ansar menyambut mereka di rumah-rumah mereka dan berbagi apa yang dimiliki. Satu kisah yang terkenal menyebut seorang lelaki Ansar menawarkan untuk berbagi hartanya kepada saudara barunya. Muhajir itu berterima kasih dan meminta ditunjukkan pasar.

Dukungan ini dikenal sebagai persaudaraan antara Muhajirin dan Ansar. Kisah itu menunjukkan kepedulian, kedermawanan, dan penghargaan terhadap usaha seseorang. Dengan dukungan masyarakat dan kerja keras mereka sendiri, banyak Muhajirin membangun kembali kehidupan. Kisah mereka mengajarkan bahwa menyambut orang lain adalah tanggung jawab bersama.
answerKey: After leaving Makkah, many Muhajirun arrived in Madinah with very little. The Ansar welcomed them into their homes and shared what they had. One well-known account tells of an Ansari man who offered to share his property with a new brother. The Muhajir thanked him and asked to be shown the market instead. This support became known as brotherhood between the Muhajirun and the Ansar. It showed care, generosity, and respect for a person's effort. With support from the community and their own hard work, many migrants rebuilt their lives. Their story teaches that welcoming people is a shared responsibility.
